title: JAK'D Chubby Salts Mango Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Chubby Salts Mango Ice from Jak’d e-liquids brings the sun-soaked flavour of fresh, juicy Mangoes to your vape with a thrilling icy twist. A layer of crisp, frosty menthol adds an irresistible touch of refreshment to the sweet mango flavour for an easy, uplifting all-day vape. Designed for vapers who like to double down on flavour, Jak'd, from legendary vape juice masters Jak’d Rabbit, delivers more than just your usual everyday e-liquid. Every Jak’d bottle contains a double-concentrated shot of flavour to make your vaping intensely tasty and satisfying. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Nicotine salts differ from regular freebase e-liquids due to their alkaline formulation, allowing for a higher nicotine concentration. The nicotine from Nic Salt e-liquids is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, offering almost instantaneous relief from nicotine cravings. The unique magic of Nic Salts means that you’ll enjoy a super-smooth, comfortable throat hit despite the higher nicotine concentration.
